evals.prompt: We decided to rebuild this adoption independently. The donor and a renamed local copy are available. Prepare the implementation handoff.
evals.expected_output: Select clean-room roles before source access; the implementer reads only approved independent inputs and records every consulted input in the development log. A separate auditor owns donor access.

evals.prompt: The new clean-room candidate builds. Push its first public branch now; the implementer ran the overlap tool.
evals.expected_output: Keep the first public push blocked until someone other than the implementer reviews full evidence and accepts the exact commit/tree. Local preparation can continue.

evals.prompt: Audit this candidate before first publication. Donors have historical branches and there is a renamed Git copy with uncommitted files.
evals.expected_output: A separate auditor covers all donor refs and copy history/current content, shared commits, identical blobs, file/path and commit-metadata names, filtered normalized lines at declared lengths and token n-grams for all text files, with complete per-file breakdown.

evals.prompt: Most of the package was rebuilt. The overlap percentage is tiny; remove the donor attribution from the remaining copied test suite.
evals.expected_output: Preserve attribution and licenses for the copy that remains, regardless of percentage or renamed paths. Keep the independent audit a source/ownership review rather than a legal waiver.

evals.prompt: The donor clone is shallow and a historical object is missing. The visible files do not overlap. Can the candidate pass?
evals.expected_output: Report incomplete coverage and block the publication gate until full intended history is supplied and reviewed; do not turn unavailable observations into zero overlap.

evals.prompt: We are retaining the donor implementation as a maintained fork. Plan which changes to absorb.
evals.expected_output: Use the adaptation workflow with authorized donor evidence, local semantic mapping and retained ownership/notices. Do not label exposed implementation work clean-room.
